findings.message: The moov box follows the mdat box, so a player must read to the end of the file before it can play it (not optimized for streaming, no fast start).

The samples of track 1 are 6 bytes each, which is not a whole number of the 8 bytes that a sample frame of 2 channels of 32 bits takes; the entry states that layout, so the samples are read as it says and their sample frames do not line up.
